sentences.en: Good evening everyone. My name's Jon and I run Veg Out, a street food business selling vegan food. Since 2012 I've been travelling all around the country cooking vegan food in my converted van and selling it at all kinds of outdoor events. I'm here to give you some advice based on my experience.
sentences.zh: 晚上好，各位。我叫乔恩，经营着一家名为“素食出街”的街头食品生意，专门售卖纯素食食品。自2012年起，我便开着改装后的厢式货车走遍全国，在各类户外活动中现场烹饪并售卖纯素食。

sentences.en: The good news is that there's never been a better time to start your own street food business. Street food continues to grow in popularity. I think there are a couple of reasons for this. The first is that street food is a reaction against fast food. Street food ranges from high quality burgers to vegan curries and everything in between. But while fast food is cheap and easy to find, it's not particularly good for you. It's also the same everywhere.
sentences.zh: 好消息是，现在开启自己的街头食品生意比以往任何时候都更合适。街头食品持续升温、广受欢迎。我认为原因有二：其一，街头食品是对快餐文化的一种反拨；街头食品种类繁多，从高品质汉堡到纯素咖喱，应有尽有。但快餐虽价格低廉、随处可得，却并不健康，且千篇一律。

sentences.en: What you get with street food on the other hand is something different. People like the idea of trying something they can't get anywhere else. They also like seeing food prepared in front of them and which hasn't come straight out of a freezer.
sentences.zh: 而街头食品则恰恰相反——它独具特色。人们乐于尝试别处吃不到的美食；也喜欢亲眼看着食物现场制作，而非直接从冰柜中取出。

sentences.en: You need to think about the best place to sell your street food. People always think music festivals are an obvious place to start but the cost of renting a space can be huge. And there's always a lot of competition. Food markets. on the other hand. are great because customers are always really interested in food and give great feedback. And if you can get a spot in your local park - fantastic. Usually very relaxed but with lots of customers passing by. Once you get established you'll start getting asked to do parties - which can be really challenging but lots of fun. Having street food at weddings has become quite fashionable too - but you need to really know what you're doing as everything needs to be perfect.
sentences.zh: 你需要认真考虑最适合售卖街头食品的地点。人们总以为音乐节是显而易见的起点，但租用摊位的费用可能极其高昂，而且竞争向来激烈。相比之下，美食市集却是极佳选择——顾客始终对美食抱有浓厚兴趣，并乐于提供宝贵反馈。若能在本地公园觅得一席之地，那就再好不过了：氛围通常轻松惬意，且人流量大。一旦站稳脚跟，你便会陆续接到派对邀约——这虽颇具挑战性，却也充满乐趣。如今在婚礼上提供街头食品也渐成风尚，但你必须对此驾轻就熟，因为一切细节都须臻于完美。

sentences.en: Setting up a street food business costs a lot less than opening a restaurant or café but you'll 011/12 011/12 013/14 013/14 have to buy some basic equipment. I'd try to get things like hobs and fridges second hand O 15 if you can. You can replace them with better quality stuff if your business takes off. Renting is another option but you'll end up spending more money rather than saving it.
sentences.zh: 开设街头食品生意所需投入远低于开餐厅或咖啡馆，但仍需购置一些基础设备。我建议尽可能二手采购炉灶、冰箱等设备；若生意蒸蒸日上，再逐步更换为更高品质的装备。租赁也是一种选择，但最终往往花费更多，而非节省开支。

sentences.en: You've probably got a good idea about the food you're planning to sell. I expect you've done some research to find out if anyone else is selling a similar product. And you'll have thought about any possible allergies to nuts or eggs etc. But there's one thing people don't always think about and that's how you're going to serve it. On a plate? In a bag? Will you provide a fork? Will it all be easily recyclable or reusable? It's got to be easy to eat and look attractive or customers won't come back.
sentences.zh: 你大概已对自己计划售卖的食品有了清晰构想。想必你也做过调研，确认是否已有他人销售同类产品；也考虑过坚果、鸡蛋等常见过敏原问题。但有一件事常被忽略——即食品的呈现方式：盛于盘中？装入纸袋？是否提供叉子？所有包装是否易于回收或重复使用？食品必须便于食用且外观诱人，否则顾客不会回头。

sentences.en: Once you get started, you should be prepared for things to go wrong. Every business faces problems and here are a few examples from street food businesses that I know.
sentences.zh: 一旦起步，你就要做好应对各种突发状况的心理准备。每家生意都会遭遇难题，以下是我所知几家街头食品商家的真实案例。

sentences.en: My friends who run Thai Basil started by juggling their street food business with their day jobs in a restaurant. Their work-life balance was non-existent as they were working til midnight in O 17 the restaurant all week and then took their food truck to markets on their days off.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友经营‘泰香罗勒’，起初一边在餐厅从事全职工作，一边兼顾街头食品生意。他们完全丧失了工作与生活的平衡——整周在餐厅工作至午夜，仅靠休息日将餐车开赴市集。

sentences.en: The owners of Basque found it was hard to make a profit because the price of fish - O 18 essential for some of their dishes - was so high. And it was hard to charge customers a lot more for those dishes. So they had to stop focussing on fish dishes and include more vegetarian food.
sentences.zh: ‘巴斯克’的经营者发现盈利艰难，因其部分招牌菜必备的鱼类成本极高；而向顾客大幅提价又难以实现。最终他们不得不减少鱼类菜品比重，转而增加素食选项。

sentences.en: The owners of Lou's kitchen were making salads to order from their van and some of their O 19 dishes were quite complicated. At one of their first events they ended up with people standing in a long queue for more than 15 minutes - and many of them lost patience. So make sure whatever you offer can be served quickly and efficiently.
sentences.zh: ‘露厨房’的经营者在厢式货车内按单制作沙拉，部分菜品工序相当复杂。在首次活动时，顾客排起长队等候逾15分钟，许多人失去耐心、愤然离去。因此，请务必确保所售食品能快速高效地完成出品。

sentences.en: The owners of Chip Chop had found a perfect venue near a beach where there weren't any other street food trucks. But what they hadn't realised was that they'd need a special licence - which individual businesses don't need at markets or festivals. It was a complicated process and in the end they gave up.
sentences.zh: ‘薯条切切’的经营者在一处临近海滩的理想场地落脚，周边并无其他街头餐车。但他们未曾意识到，该地点需申领特殊执照——而此类执照在市集或音乐节等场合并非个体商户必需。申办流程极为繁琐，最终他们只得放弃。

sentences.en: So I hope that's given you a flavour of....
sentences.zh: 希望以上分享能让大家对……有所了解。
